payload.title: Unify Add a reference entry point (URL + optional file import)
payload.description: One 'Add a reference' area: Paste a URL (unchanged) or, only with a curation session, Import a file (shared panel). Editor-facing copy free of engine terms. Specs: cancel/reject commits nothing; web candidate preview shows full model_representation and provenance; no session renders URL only. Part of PPY-7227ac (Kanbus forbids a task under a story).
